hero.lead: Six disciplines, one goal: software that's reliable on day one and still easy to change on day one thousand.

items.title: Full-Stack Development
items.summary: Complete, scalable web applications from front to back, with seamless integration between intuitive interfaces and powerful backend systems.

items.title: Software Design & Architecture
items.summary: Scalable, maintainable and secure architectures with proper SDD documentation, built to be portable, interoperable and future-ready.

items.title: UI/UX & Design
items.summary: Turning raw ideas into intuitive experiences: seamless user journeys, elegant wireframes, and modern aesthetics.

items.title: Cloud & DevOps
items.summary: Automated deployments, managed cloud infrastructure, and reliable delivery pipelines with modern DevOps practice.

items.title: Data Engineering
items.summary: Data pipelines, ETL systems, and analytics-ready architectures that keep business data clean, accessible and actionable.

items.title: Network Engineering
items.summary: Reliable network infrastructure: configuration, security and optimization for high availability and efficient data flow.

items.title: Discover
items.text: Requirements, stakeholders and constraints, written down in an SRS before any code.

items.title: Design
items.text: Architecture, data model and wireframes that the whole team can review.

items.title: Build
items.text: Small, tested increments with clean, documented code and regular demos.

items.title: Ship
items.text: Automated deploys, a handover document, and support while it settles.

items.title: Project
items.text: A defined scope with a clear deliverable, from a landing page to a full web app.

items.title: Contract
items.text: Extra engineering capacity for your team, working inside your tools and process.

items.title: Full-time / Internship
items.text: A long-term role where I can grow with the product and the team.

items.q: Which technologies do you work with?
items.a: Mostly React and Next.js on the frontend, Node.js, Python, .NET and C++ on the backend, and SQL Server or MongoDB for data. The full list is on the About page.
Yes. I'm based in Multan, Pakistan (PKT, UTC+5) and work remotely or on-site.
Send a message through the contact page with a short description of the project. I'll reply within 24–48 hours to set up a call.

items.q: Can you take over an existing codebase?
items.a: Yes. I start by reading the code and documenting how it works, then make small, safe changes from there.
